title: Commit Your Plans to the Lord
story:
A young man had a dream of building a small business of his own.

He spent weeks making plans, calculating costs, choosing a location, and imagining how successful the business could become.

He was excited, but he was also worried. There were many things he could not control.

One evening, he spoke with his father about his plans. His father listened carefully and said, "Planning is good, but do not carry the whole burden by yourself. Commit your plans to God and ask Him to guide your steps."

The young man realized that he had been asking God to bless his plans without first placing those plans completely in God's hands.

He began to pray differently.

Instead of saying, "God, make my plan succeed," he began saying, "Lord, if this is Your will, guide me. Change my plans where necessary and help me follow Your direction."

Proverbs 16:3 teaches us to commit our works to the Lord, and our plans will be established.

This does not mean that every plan we make will happen exactly as we expect.

Sometimes God changes our direction because He sees what we cannot see.

A door we desperately want may close. A plan may take longer than expected. An opportunity may disappear. Something we thought was a setback may eventually become a blessing.

When we commit our plans to God, we are not asking Him simply to approve everything we want.

We are surrendering our plans to His wisdom.

This gives us peace.

We can work hard without being controlled by anxiety. We can plan carefully without believing that everything depends entirely on us.

We can accept changes without losing hope because our future is in God's hands.

Perhaps you are making an important decision today about your career, family, finances, studies, relationships, or future.

Make your plans, but take them to God.

Ask Him for wisdom. Ask Him to close the wrong doors and open the right ones. Be willing to change direction when He leads you differently.

God cares about the details of your life.

When you place your work and plans in His hands, you can move forward with faith instead of fear.

Do your part faithfully, trust God's wisdom, and leave the final outcome with Him.
life_lesson: Planning is important, but our plans should be surrendered to God. When we commit our work and future to Him, we can move forward with wisdom, peace, and trust instead of anxiety.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for caring about every part of my life and future.

I place my plans, dreams, responsibilities, and decisions into Your hands.

Forgive me for the times when I make my plans first and only ask You afterward to bless them.

Teach me to seek Your will before making important decisions.

Give me wisdom to plan carefully and humility to change my plans when You lead me in a different direction.

When a door closes, help me trust that You may be protecting me or leading me toward something better.

When things take longer than expected, give me patience.

When I face uncertainty, give me peace and help me remember that my future is in Your hands.

Help me work diligently without becoming controlled by worry or fear.

Establish the work of my hands according to Your purpose and use my efforts for Your glory.

Help me recognize the opportunities You provide and have the courage to follow Your direction.

I surrender my plans to You today. Lead me, correct me, and guide me according to Your perfect wisdom.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there a plan or decision in your life that you have not fully surrendered to God?

Are you asking God to guide your plans, or mainly asking Him to bless what you have already decided?

What is one important area of your life that you can place completely in God's hands today?
verse: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and He will establish your plans.
